jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) ORCHIDÉE LUMIÈRE LIQUID SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Comes in a container with dispenser.

Orchidée Lumière | The orchid flower exudes a sensual and mysterious fragrance, where facets of black vanilla envelop an elegant floral bouquet and add a final touch of rich warmth.

Notes:
Top notes: citrus cocktail, Italian lemon oil, fruity.
Heart notes: orchid, Egyptian jasmine, lily of the valley, freesia, gardenia.
Base notes: wood, cedar, cedar oil, musk, vanilla.
